title: Mater Misericordiae
html_source: The Mater Misericordiae University Hospital (commonly known as the Mater or MMUH (Irish: Ospidéal an Mater Misercordiae)) is a major teaching hospital, based at Eccles Street, Phibsboro, on the northside of Dublin, Ireland. Mater misericordiae means “mother of mercy” in Latin and alludes to its founders, the Sisters of Mercy.
